result.description:
At Riot, we believe in putting players first. Our Sydney-based team is partnering globally to build next-generation features and technology on an exciting Unpublished R&D Title. The team focuses on supporting the game's visual targets and content production needs - helping our artists to realize a vibrant and rich world for players to be immersed and express themselves in.

As a Senior Technical Artist, Tools & Pipeline, you’ll shape the creative engine that powers our teams - defining and elevating end-to-end workflows across disciplines including Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX. You’ll be a strategic partner to artists, Technical Art, and Engineering, evaluating tools and pipelines, clarifying production requirements, and ensuring our workflows enable creativity at scale. Your work will directly impact how ideas move from concept to shipped content, empowering multiple teams to operate efficiently in parallel production streams.

In this role, you’ll help stand up and sustain scalable tools and processes, providing hands-on technical support while gathering data and feedback to continuously improve the artist experience. You’ll build strong cross-disciplinary relationships to uncover pain points and guide meaningful system and pipeline improvements. As an active member of Riot’s Technical Art community, you’ll mentor fellow TAs, contribute to craft growth, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing through clear documentation and open feedback. By setting clear goals, offering actionable direction, and championing continuous improvement, you’ll ensure our workflows not only support today’s production but evolve to meet the ambitions of tomorrow.

You will report to the Manager, Technical Art, and work closely with the Technical Art Director and other members of the team abroad.

Responsibilities:
Define and level up the end-to-end workflow for our many creative disciplines, such as Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX
Collaborate with Technical Art and Engineering partners to support artist needs, including evaluating tools and workflows, and communicating requirements for production.
Help stand up and maintain scalable artist tools and workflows to support multiple teams in parallel production streams.
Provide technical support to artists working from our art workflows, collecting data to further improve the tools they are using, making recommendations and improvements where necessary
Be an active member of the Tech Art community within Riot, participate in craft-focused meetings and events, and actively mentor for other Technical Artists in their craft
Build close relationships with artists and engineers to understand needs, identify pain points, and help guide workflow, pipeline, and system improvements.
Spread knowledge of the team’s processes through documentation and help teams expand their technical know-how
Consistently give and take constructive feedback, direct next steps, and communicate clear goals and outcomes to your team

Required Qualifications: 
6+ years of professional experience as a technical artist in games or related industries.
Professional experience in content creation and tool development for DCC tools, such as Autodesk Maya, 3DS Max, Adobe Suite, ZBrush, Houdini, Substance Suite, or Blender.
Professional experience working in Unreal Engine 5.
Highly proficient in Python tool development, with a particular focus on building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance tools for a variety of artist use-cases.
Professional experience with modern UI frameworks such as PySide & PyQt.
Strong understanding of art workflows and the ability to translate artistic needs into technical requirements.
Highly proficient communication skills and capacity to act as an ambassador between art and engineering.
Superb critical thinking skills, particularly as it pertains to translating artistic requirements to sustainable workflow design.
Proactive, responsible, and comfortable owning ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

Desired Qualifications:
Experience with C++ and UMG for Unreal Engine 5.
Excellent UI/UX design and front-end development (especially Qt/PyQt).
Strong understanding of performance considerations for modern hardware and optimization techniques required for delivering a scalable, high performance product.
Experience working on a large-scale, AAA game with a sizable, cross-disciplinary team.
Experience with character rigging and animation pipelines.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

•	Switchboard manufacturing experience and a sound knowledge of Australian standards

•	Experience with control wiring and fault finding

•	Good communication and interpersonal skills

•	High regard for safety and a healthy working environment

•	Attention to details

Electrical Engineering Technician

•	Monitor radio traffic efficiently to guarantee accurate transmission and reception of voice messages.

•	Expertly install electronic instruments and control systems to enhance functionality.

*Must have:

Seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to work on the integration of mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering into cohesive systems. Candidates should have expertise in robotics, control systems, and smart technologies, and be able to innovate and improve product functionalities.
Mining Engineer

Industrial Engineer

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Web Administrator to join our team and take ownership of our web presence, infrastructure, and digital platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining websites while delivering reliable web technology solutions that support the organisation's objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our web environments are secure, performant, and continuously optimised. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications, ensuring consistent functionality, visual integrity, and a positive user experience across all platforms
- Monitor and manage web server performance, uptime, and availability, responding promptly to incidents and implementing preventative measures to minimise disruption
- Administer and configure web hosting environments, domains, DNS settings, and SSL certificates to ensure secure and reliable operation
- Collaborate with content, marketing, and development teams to publish, update, and manage web content in accordance with brand guidelines and accessibility standards
- Implement and maintain web security protocols, including regular vulnerability assessments, software patching, and user access controls to safeguard digital assets
- Analyse web traffic data and performance metrics using analytics tools, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve engagement and site effectiveness
- Manage and maintain content management systems (CMS), including configuration, plugin or module updates, and user permission management
- Develop and enforce web standards, coding best practices, and documentation to ensure consistency and maintainability across all web properties
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to websites, web applications, and integrations in a timely and effective manner
- Support the planning and execution of website migrations, upgrades, and redesign projects, coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors as required
- Conduct regular audits of website content, links, and functionality to identify and rectify errors, broken pages, or outdated information
- Provide technical guidance and support to internal users on web-related tools, platforms, and best practices
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Proven experience in a web administration, web development, or similar technical role
- Proficiency in core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Hands-on experience administering web servers such as Apache or Nginx, and working within Linux or Windows server environments
- Solid understanding of DNS management, domain administration, SSL/TLS certificates, and web hosting infrastructure
- Experience managing content management systems such as WordPress, Drupal, or similar platforms
- Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar, with the ability to interpret data and report findings clearly
- Working knowledge of web security best practices, including vulnerability management and access control
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Google Analytics, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or CompTIA Security+
- Experience with version control systems such as Git and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows
- Knowledge of PHP, Python, or other server-side scripting languages
- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
- Exposure to cloud-based hosting platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure
- Experience working within agile or collaborative project delivery environments
- Familiarity with web performance optimisation techniques, including caching strategies and content delivery networks (CDNs)
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and shared success
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and attendance at industry events
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options that support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and meaningful projects that have a genuine impact on the organisation's digital presence and growth
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits and a supportive, inclusive workplace culture
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Cyber Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist to lead the implementation and continuous improvement of our organisation’s cybersecurity governance framework. This position is pivotal in ensuring that our systems, data, and infrastructure adhere to internal policies and external regulatory obligations, while proactively managing cyber risk and compliance across the enterprise.
You will work closely with executive leadership, IT teams, and external stakeholders to develop strategies, monitor controls, and report on risk posture, audit outcomes, and compliance metrics.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and management of cybersecurity governance frameworks, including policies, standards, and procedures aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, Essential Eight, and other relevant standards.
Perform risk assessments and control evaluations to identify cybersecurity risks across infrastructure, applications, and third-party vendors.
Develop and maintain the organisation’s information security risk register and assist in the treatment planning and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal and external audits related to cybersecurity and manage compliance reporting (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, CPS 234, GDPR).
Provide expert advice to business and IT leaders regarding security requirements, regulatory changes, and risk implications of new projects or technologies.
Monitor compliance with security policies, identify gaps, and drive remediation in collaboration with system and security teams.
Develop metrics and reporting dashboards for executive oversight of cyber risk, control effectiveness, and incident trends.
Lead training and awareness initiatives to embed a culture of security and compliance across all departments.
Liaise with external auditors, regulators, and compliance authorities where required.
Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a cybersecurity GRC or Information Security Compliance role.
Strong understanding of risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 27005, NIST RMF, FAIR), and regulatory standards (e.g., CPS 234, GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOX).
Demonstrated experience leading internal/external security audits and vendor risk assessments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including report writing and executive briefings.
Familiarity with GRC platforms and SIEM tools (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, Splunk, Microsoft Defender).
Relevant certifications preferred: CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent.
Why Join Us?
Work with a dedicated team driving cyber resilience across the organisation.
High-visibility role influencing security posture and risk culture at the executive level.
Career development and upskilling opportunities in a supportive environment.
Flexible working arrangements with a hybrid or remote-friendly structure.

About the business and the role  

You will be working for a national safety wholesaler with a Perth Head Office. You will be working from your own home office.
Ideally, you are located in Brisbane metro area.

Your role will be to 
1. Manage an existing wholesale client list;
2. Grow the client base with new clients; and
3. Cross selling products to the existing customers. 

The role is an autonomous role, reporting directly to the directors of the company based Perth. 

The business is a family owned company and has been in operation since 1980. The company imports and wholesales consumable safety products including hard hats, gloves, glasses, respirators, and much more. 

The fast changing pace of the industry ensures you are always challenged with different ideas and helping clients solve problems. 

The industry has many standards and we can help you improve your technical knowledge with our in-house training program. 

Job tasks and responsibilities  
The QLD/TAS Account Manager is responsible for servicing key regions including all of Queensland, NSW Northern Rivers. The area also includes all of Tasmania. Due to current structure, the role includes servicing a segment of Victoria.

The role provides great opportunity for travel throughout the key regions. 

You are responsible for planning your call cycles and regional travels to ensure clients are kept up to date with the latest developments. You will work closely with your interstate counterparts in NSW and WA.

In working with the customers, you may be required to undertake joint calls with your customer to visit the end users. 

You are required to report on sales actuals compared to budget on a monthly basis as well as prepare weekly call reports, and update Master Run Sheets.

The role requires you to participate in trade shows/events. 

Skills and experience  
An industrial and safety background is ideal but not mandatory. 

You must have a car to perform this role. 

Competent computer skills are important including being proficient at using Word, Excel, Outlook and Internet. 

A business to business sales call background is ideal. 

This role is open only to Australian Residents/Citizens. 

Successful candidates will be contacted for a phone interview and thereafter a video call and or a face to face interview.

Job benefits and perks  
A salary and motor vehicle allowance is provided. 
Mobile phone with calls and data is covered.
